answer: Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 6 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in whisper and forge lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the haven graph. Verification costs 8 dollars and 1 days per identity, which turns a 4696 account sybil into a 9 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
